_설명: 천일문 2권 워크북 Chapter 04 수동태의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 기본 9과 수동태와 능동태 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 수동태의 시제: 과거는 was/were+p.p., 미래는 will be+p.p.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • The two islands ____(A)____ by a long bridge.
• Our class flag ____(B)____ by Mina at the school festival.

choices.text: connect — raised
connected — was raised
connected — raised
are connect — raised
are connected — was raised

questions.point_label: be pleased with, be known for
questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • I was very pleased ____(A)____ her gift.
• Edison is known ____(B)____ the light bulb.

choices.text: in — as
in — with
with — as
with — for
from — for

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Wheat isn’t grow in this area.
Will the soup made by the chef?
Your shoes must be clean before class.
A few decades ago, computers not were used.
The new library will be opened next spring.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: The chair was made by plastic.
The box was filled of old photos.
Students are usually interested in music.
Mr. Han won’t be satisfied for my essay.
The floor is covered dust.

questions.prompt: 주어진 단어를 빈칸에 어법상 알맞은 형태로 쓰세요.
body: These fresh apples ________ ________ by Jinho a few days ago. (send)

questions.prompt: 주어진 단어를 빈칸에 어법상 알맞은 형태로 쓰세요.
body: Penguins ________ ________ ________ on this island. (can, see)

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열할 때, 세 번째로 오는 단어를 고르세요.
body: 나는 우리 형에 의해 이 자전거를 받았다.
(my brother / given / I / this / by / was / bicycle)

choices.text: was
bicycle
my brother
given
by

body: Sora will bring Jiho to the concert.
questions.answer: Jiho will be brought to the concert by Sora.

body: The teacher collected the papers.
questions.answer: The papers were collected by the teacher.

choices.text: A: Is Spanish spoken in Mexico?  B: Yes, it is.
A: How was the vase broken?  B: It was broken by the cat.
A: Was the necklace made of silver?  B: No, it wasn’t. It was made of gold.
A: Were the tulips planted by Mina?  B: Yes, they were. Mina planted them last week.
A: When was the first World Cup held?  B: They held in 1930.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Last night, the dishes did by my brother.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The mountain cannot be see through the fog.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Was written the novel by a young author?
questions.answer: Was written the novel → Was the novel written

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ The money will donate to the shelter.
ⓑ The fire was caused by a candle.
ⓒ The new laptop is made in Japan.
ⓓ Korean dramas are watched all over the world.
ⓔ The missing wallet was found under the sofa.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: The letter [[was hidden]] for many years.
The hill [[is covered]] with white snow.
Many birds [[were caught]] by the net.
The wall [[will painted]] again by my uncle next week.
Korean food [[is enjoyed]] by people around the world.

body: 학생들은 선생님께 존경을 표해야 한다.
<조건> • should, show라는 단어가 들어가게 쓸 것  • 능동태와 수동태 두 가지 형태를 모두 쓸 것  • 필요한 경우 제시된 단어를 변형하여 쓸 것
(1) Students ________ ________ respect to teachers.
questions.answer: (1) should show  (2) should be shown, by students
